connections.choice.gone: A removed connection (the agent is refused a start)
connections.choice.label: Connection
connections.choice.none: No {cli} connection is on in this workspace. Add one in Settings → Connections.
connections.choice.noneCli: No {cli} account is on in this workspace. Add one in Settings → Accounts & Connections.
connections.choice.noneHere: No account is on in this workspace. Add one in Settings → Accounts & Connections.
connections.choice.off: {name} (off in this workspace: the default runs it)
connections.choice.offHere: {name} (its account is off here: its CLI's first usable connection runs it)
connections.choice.removed: A removed connection (its CLI's first usable one runs it)
connections.intro.text: Agents now run on accounts: add one for {clis} in Settings → Accounts & Connections and sign it in there. Hive no longer uses the sign-in of your own terminal, which stays as it is.
connections.mark.anotherMark: Running on another connection than the one chosen
connections.mark.deletedTip: The connection chosen for it was removed: it can't start until you choose another in its Agent Settings, or the workspace's default.
connections.mark.inherited: {name}: the workspace's default for {cli}, which it follows
connections.mark.noneTip: No {cli} connection is on in this workspace: it can't start until one is (Settings → Connections).
connections.mark.noneUsable: No {cli} account is on in this workspace: it can't start until one is (Settings → Accounts & Connections).
connections.mark.offFallback: {wanted} is off in this workspace: the default, {name}, runs it
connections.mark.offHere: {wanted} is on an account that's off in this workspace: {name}, its CLI's first usable connection, runs it
connections.mark.offNoDefaultTip: {wanted} is off in this workspace, and no other {cli} connection is on: it can't start until one is (Settings → Connections).
connections.mark.offNoDefaultUsable: {wanted} is off in this workspace, and no other {cli} account is on: it can't start until one is (Settings → Accounts & Connections).
connections.mark.other: Runs on {running} until it restarts. Chosen now: {chosen}
connections.mark.otherProviderTip: {wanted} is for another CLI than {cli}: it can't start until you choose one of its own in its Agent Settings.
connections.mark.removed: The connection chosen for it was removed: {name}, its CLI's first usable connection, runs it until you choose another in its Agent Settings
